text.lead: Artik is a 2019 American horror film written and directed by Tom Botchii. It stars Chase Williamson, Jerry G. Angelo and Lauren Ashley Carter. The film had its international premiere at Macabro and world premiere at Popcorn Frights.
text.plot: A comic book obsessed serial killer Artik teaches his son how to avoid a series of brutal murders until the boy reaches a mysterious man who blocks everything.
text.cast:
- Chase Williamson as Holton
- Jerry G. Angelo as Artik
- Lauren Ashley Carter as Flin Brays
- Matt Mercer as Kar
- Gavin White as Boy Adam
text.reception:
Critical response:
Review aggregator website, Rotten Tomatoes gave it 100% rating, based on six reviews.
Accolades:
